blocks.text: 17. Storage, Transport and Disposal
17.1 Storage
17.1.1 Storage of the BactoSense
Preparations
blocks.html: Preparations

blocks.text: WORK STEP 1. Make sure the manual sampling device is installed 2. Perform a Clean sampling device with Washstation process, as described in Clean manual sampling device with Washstation . Alternatively, if no Washstation is available, follow the procedure in Clean manual sampling device with basic cleaning . 3. Leave an empty tube or empty Washstation attached to the manual sampling device. 4. Follow the cartridge removal procedure in Removing a cartridge to safely remove the cartridge. Note: Cartridge removal is not required if the storage conditions of the cartridge can also be fulfilled. 5. Power off the BactoSense. 6. Unplug the power supply unit from the mains power supply, then unplug the power supply plug from the BactoSense. 7. Make sure the USB, Ethernet and power sockets are covered with the attached covers. 8. Pack the BactoSense with attached manual sampling device in its standard cardboard box with foam inserts, or in the transport case.
blocks.html:
WORK STEP
1.Make sure the manual sampling device is installed
2.Perform a Clean sampling device with Washstation process, as described in Clean manual sampling device with Washstation. Alternatively, if no Washstation is available, follow the procedure in Clean manual sampling device with basic cleaning.
3.Leave an empty tube or empty Washstation attached to the manual sampling device.
4.Follow the cartridge removal procedure in Removing a cartridge to safely remove the cartridge. Note: Cartridge removal is not required if the storage conditions of the cartridge can also be fulfilled.
5.Power off the BactoSense.
6.Unplug the power supply unit from the mains power supply, then unplug the power supply plug from the BactoSense.
7.Make sure the USB, Ethernet and power sockets are covered with the attached covers.
8.Pack the BactoSense with attached manual sampling device in its standard cardboard box with foam inserts, or in the transport case.

blocks.text: Storage
blocks.html: Storage

blocks.text: Store the BactoSense according to the following storage conditions:
blocks.html: Store the BactoSense according to the following storage conditions:

blocks.text: Temperature between 15 °C and 25 °C (59 °F – 77 °F) Relative humidity between 10 % and 70 % Non-vibrating, non-corrosive, dark and clean environment
blocks.html:
• Temperature between 15 °C and 25 °C (59 °F – 77 °F)
  • Relative humidity between 10 % and 70 %
  • Non-vibrating, non-corrosive, dark and clean environment

blocks.text: Re-installation
blocks.html: Re-installation

blocks.text: After storage, follow the general installation instructions described in Installation .
blocks.html: After storage, follow the general installation instructions described in Installation.

blocks.text: Validate after storage If the BactoSense has been stored for more than one month, perform an instrument validation using the Validation Kit before the first measurement to ensure proper functioning.
blocks.html:
INFO: Validate after storage

If the BactoSense has been stored for more than one month, perform an instrument validation using the Validation Kit before the first measurement to ensure proper functioning.

blocks.text: 17.1.2 Storage of the sampling devices
Note: The BactoSense should always have a sampling device installed. This procedure refers to storage of additional sampling devices if available.
blocks.html: Note: The BactoSense should always have a sampling device installed. This procedure refers to storage of additional sampling devices if available.

blocks.text: Preparations
blocks.html: Preparations

blocks.text: WORK STEP ADDITIONAL INFO / IMAGES 1. Remove and clean the sampling device according to the instructions in Removal of the manual sampling device (manual sampling device) or Removal of the online sampling device (online sampling device). Wear gloves during the process to prevent sampling device contamination. If the tubings of the online sampling device show any signs of contamination or damage, do not reuse and discard. 2. Cover the cleaned sampling device with the dedicated cap if available. 3. Store the clean sampling device in a clean and dry plastic bag.
blocks.html:
WORK STEPADDITIONAL INFO / IMAGES
1.Remove and clean the sampling device according to the instructions in Removal of the manual sampling device (manual sampling device) or Removal of the online sampling device (online sampling device).Wear gloves during the process to prevent sampling device contamination. If the tubings of the online sampling device show any signs of contamination or damage, do not reuse and discard.
2.Cover the cleaned sampling device with the dedicated cap if available.
3.Store the clean sampling device in a clean and dry plastic bag.

blocks.text: 17.1.3 Storage of the cartridge

Protect against leaking chemicals Wear protective gloves and goggles. Leaking chemicals can cause skin irritation, eye damage and other health hazards. Make sure the liquid connectors of the cartridge are all tightly sealed with the respective plugs.
blocks.html:
WARNING: Protect against leaking chemicals

Wear protective gloves and goggles. Leaking chemicals can cause skin irritation, eye damage and other health hazards. Make sure the liquid connectors of the cartridge are all tightly sealed with the respective plugs.

blocks.text: Check cartridge expiry Check the expiration date of the cartridge. The expiration date is printed on the handle of the cartridge in the format Day/Month/Year, or can be found on the instrument user interface under Home → Settings → System info.
blocks.html:
INFO: Check cartridge expiry

Check the expiration date of the cartridge. The expiration date is printed on the handle of the cartridge in the format Day/Month/Year, or can be found on the instrument user interface under Home → Settings → System info.

Make sure the liquid connectors of the cartridge are all tightly sealed with the respective plugs. 4. Pack the cartridge in its original cardboard box with foam inserts.

blocks.text: 17.3.1 Returning the BactoSense
Preparations
blocks.html: Preparations

blocks.text: WORK STEP 1. If the instrument has been exposed to hazardous substances, fully decontaminate it and provide a certificate of decontamination. 2. Make sure the manual sampling device is installed. 3. Perform a Clean sampling device with Washstation process, as described in Clean manual sampling device with Washstation . Alternatively, if no Washstation is available, follow the procedure in Clean manual sampling device with basic cleaning . 4. Leave an empty tube or empty Washstation attached to the manual sampling device 5. Follow the cartridge removal procedure in Removing a cartridge to safely remove the cartridge. 6. Power off the BactoSense. 7. Unplug the power supply unit from the mains power supply, then unplug the power supply plug from the BactoSense. 8. Make sure the USB, Ethernet and power sockets are covered with the attached covers. 9. Pack the BactoSense with manual sampling device but without cartridge in its standard cardboard box and fixate the box on a pallet or skid. 10. If you ship additional items, label them with the serial number of the BactoSense. 11. Indicate with stickers that the contents of the parcels are fragile, shall be kept dry, and shall only be transported in the indicated orientation.
blocks.html:
WORK STEP
1.If the instrument has been exposed to hazardous substances, fully decontaminate it and provide a certificate of decontamination.
2.Make sure the manual sampling device is installed.
3.Perform a Clean sampling device with Washstation process, as described in Clean manual sampling device with Washstation. Alternatively, if no Washstation is available, follow the procedure in Clean manual sampling device with basic cleaning.
4.Leave an empty tube or empty Washstation attached to the manual sampling device
5.Follow the cartridge removal procedure in Removing a cartridge to safely remove the cartridge.
6.Power off the BactoSense.
7.Unplug the power supply unit from the mains power supply, then unplug the power supply plug from the BactoSense.
8.Make sure the USB, Ethernet and power sockets are covered with the attached covers.
9.Pack the BactoSense with manual sampling device but without cartridge in its standard cardboard box and fixate the box on a pallet or skid.
10.If you ship additional items, label them with the serial number of the BactoSense.
11.Indicate with stickers that the contents of the parcels are fragile, shall be kept dry, and shall only be transported in the indicated orientation.

blocks.text: Return Ship the BactoSense to bNovate or distribution partner, adhering to the general storage temperature and humidity requirements listed in Technical data and Storage of the BactoSense .
blocks.html: Return Ship the BactoSense to bNovate or distribution partner, adhering to the general storage temperature and humidity requirements listed in Technical data and Storage of the BactoSense.

blocks.text: 17.4 Recycling and disposal

The disposal of the BactoSense, accessories and consumables has to be carried out in compliance with regional statutory regulations. The BactoSense contains no environmentally damaging sources of radiation.
